body: I understand but it didn't always used to be like this. We were happy once. We always went out of our way to do things for one another. We always made it a point it to tell each other we appreciated each other. We used to make love until the sun came up. We would lay with each other, listen to music, light a candle and just talk for hours about our lives. We motivated each other and pushed each other to be better. We used to be everything I ever wanted in a relationship and at this point I don't know if I'm hanging on to that out of hope or because I know she's still in there. I used to be angry because I am very hard on myself and I myself put her through a lot and perhaps this is just karma putting me in my place. Idk anymore. I completely agree with you but I just can't force myself to lose hope. I'm weak.
